The following text is taken and summarised from https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Character/Level_Scaling

Characters' base HP, ATK and DEF are determined by base values, level multipliers and ascension values.

For their bonus attributes, values are determined by base values and the ascension multiplier.

Values in tables are rounded, but the actual values used in the game are decimals with more digits, so using these values to calculate will often result in some small rounding error.


For calculations, Stat Value = Base Value × Level Multiplier + Ascension Value

Different characters have different base values for base attributes.

Alternatively, the HP and DEF multiplier for every level and the ATK multiplier for level 1 to 90 only can be derived from the following formulas:

Level Multiplier Base = Multiplier Start + (Level − Level Start) × Rate = 1 + (Level−1) x 9/109 = (100 + 9 x Level) / 109

Level Multiplier 4-Star = round(Level Multiplier Base, 3)

Level Multiplier 5-Star = round(Level Multiplier Base x (1900 + Level) / 1901, 3)

Where  round(,3) means rounding to 3 decimal places.

Ascension Value

Ascension Value = Max Ascension Value × Ascension Multiplier

Ascension Multiplier
Ascension Phase	0	1	2	3	4	5	6
Multiplier	0/182 38/182 65/182 101/182 128/182 155/182 182/182

Bonus Attribute

For calculations,

Bonus Attribute Value = Base Value × Ascension Multiplier

Base Value
Different characters have different stats and base values of bonus attributes.

Stat	4-Star Base Value	5-Star Base Value
Elemental DMG Bonus	6%	7.2%
ATK	6%	7.2%
HP	6%	7.2%
DEF	7.5%	9%
Physical DMG Bonus	7.5%	9%
Energy Recharge	6.7%	8%
Elemental Mastery	24	28.8
Healing Bonus	4.62%	5.54%
CRIT Rate	—	4.8%
CRIT DMG	—	9.6%

Ascension Multiplier
For bonus attributes, values will increase in ascension phases 2/3/5/6.

Ascension Phase	1	2	3	4	5	6
Multiplier	0	1	2	2	3	4
